# Tharun Kumar Reddy

> AI & Data Engineer in Bengaluru, India. Takes LLMs from demo to production: RAG assistants, real-time voice agents, Claude & MCP connectors and agentic automation, built on solid data platforms with the latency, accuracy and guardrails that make people trust them.

## Key facts
- Role: Data Engineer at Easystepin IT Services Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru (since June 2024).
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science, Sri Venkateswara Engineering College, Tirupati (2021-2024).
- Availability: open to AI engineering roles, consulting and ambitious builds in agents, RAG, voice and automation.
- Selected results: 40% lower RAG query latency; sub-800ms end-to-end voice agent; 95% field accuracy on 500+ invoices per day; 10 forecasting APIs; 60+ n8n workflows on 17 shared subflows.
- Location: Bengaluru, India.
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/tharun-kumar-reddy-b-a545a9204/, https://github.com/tharunkumarreddyy

## Essays
- [RAG Is Not the Hard Part](__SITE_URL__/writing/rag-is-not-the-hard-part/): Standing up a retrieval pipeline is a weekend project now. Grounding, abstention, and multi-source retrieval are where real systems actually live or die.
- [Why MCP Is More Than a Buzzword](__SITE_URL__/writing/why-mcp-is-more-than-a-buzzword/): Every agent framework invents its own way to call tools. MCP is the first serious attempt to standardize that interface - here's why that matters more than the model underneath.
- [The Boring Infrastructure Behind Reliable AI Systems](__SITE_URL__/writing/boring-infrastructure-behind-reliable-ai/): Nobody gets excited about tracing spans or eval harnesses. They're also the difference between a demo and a system that survives three weeks of real usage.
- [Multi-Tenant SaaS: The Scaling Decisions Nobody Talks About](__SITE_URL__/writing/multi-tenant-saas-scaling-decisions/): Adding multi-tenancy gets treated like a checkbox. In practice it's a series of trade-offs about isolation, fairness, and what happens when one tenant misbehaves.
- [Data Quality Is a Trust Problem, Not a Testing Problem](__SITE_URL__/writing/data-quality-is-a-trust-problem/): Schema tests and not-null checks catch known failure modes. They don't answer the question a stakeholder actually asks: can I trust this number?
- [Automation Is a Data Engineering Problem](__SITE_URL__/writing/automation-is-a-data-engineering-problem/): A drag-and-drop workflow tool feels like a different discipline from a data pipeline. At any real scale, it fails in exactly the same ways.
